extension.description: Stremio for Kodi program addon with embedded Nimbus Home and media information. Nimbus layouts and artwork by Ivar Brandt. Kodi remains the playback engine; the global Kodi skin is unchanged.
extension.news: 1.0.43: Add optional free BYOK Gemini AI subtitle translation with local API-key settings, whole-track SRT/WebVTT translation, exact cue/timestamp preservation, translated-file caching and original-subtitle fallback. Vortexo Premium hosted AI is shown as in construction; planned at $4.99 USD/month with no API key required.
